en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad and Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar altogether from Al Hajjal, from Sa’alba, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It is upon you with (eating) the endive, for it increased in the water, and improves the child birth, and it is hot, soft, increasing in the male children’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Abu Ali al-Ash‘ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar all from al-Hajj al from Tha’labah from a man who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once said, ‘
You must eat endives because it increases one’s seed and forms children well. It is hot, soft and increases male children.’”
